name: hyssong-fmripreprocessing
desc: Post-fMRIPrep nuisance regression and smoothing (AFNI/FSL), ported from Hayoung Song's fmripreprocessing notebook

tr.desc: Repetition time (seconds) of the BOLD acquisition

fd_thres.desc: Framewise displacement threshold (mm) used to flag/censor high-motion frames

fwhm.desc: Full-width half-max (mm) of the spatial smoothing kernel applied at the end

hpass_cutoff.desc: High-pass filter cutoff frequency in Hz (default 0.0078 Hz corresponds to a 128s period)

inputs.desc: Brain mask matching the BOLD input (from fMRIPrep)
fMRIPrep confounds regressors.tsv for the same BOLD run

outputs.desc: Brain-masked, intensity-normalized, nuisance-regressed (24 motion parameters + WM + CSF + global signal + high-pass), and spatially smoothed BOLD, ready for functional-connectivity analyses.
